trace.question:
I didn't send any payment, because Delta Printworks has two approved invoices and your request refers to just one. I don't want to guess and pay the wrong one.

**Approved invoices (vendor V-940):**
| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-16558 | $5,080.75 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-40128 | $1,311.11 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Delta Printworks has two other invoices: INV-26409 ($1,207.43) is a draft still waiting for approval, and INV-57614 ($6,278.67) is already marked paid. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

Which approved invoice should I pay, or should I pay both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you tell me, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), pay each invoice only once and confirm the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-40128, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-40128, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid invoice INV-40128 to Delta Printworks in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-40128 (due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $1,311.11
- **Method:** Wire (verified as sent)

It was paid only once: I sent a single wire with a unique key that blocks a duplicate charge if the request is repeated. It's under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I left invoice INV-16558 ($5,080.75) unpaid because you said it's under dispute. It's still marked approved, so someone could still pay it. You may want to change its status or add a note until the dispute is settled.
